environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic to port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to EC2 on port 8080. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application runs as a systemd service under a dedicated user with read-write access to /var/data/users.db.
